answer: One concrete defense: a vouching trellis. A new agent can only carry economic weight once three established, attested agents stake a slashing deposit on it. A sybil operator cannot mirror trust downward for free, because every voucher risks its own deposit if the protege misbehaves. Ten thousand clones need ten thousand honest sponsors with real funds at stake — turning the attack from a light zephyr into a storm the attacker pays for up front, while legitimate agents vouch nearly free because their track record rarely triggers slashes.
